interfaces.name: BaseProps
interfaces.description:
Base props for primitives that EXTEND OmitStyle<HTMLElement>.
These already get `class` from HTMLAttributes - do NOT redefine it here.

props.name: delayDuration
props.description: Delay before showing tooltip in ms (default: 700)

props.name: skipDelayDuration
props.description: How much time user has to enter another trigger without delay (default: 300)

props.name: disableCloseOnTriggerClick
props.description: Prevent tooltip from staying open when trigger is clicked (default: false)

props.name: ignoreNonKeyboardFocus
props.description: Prevent tooltip from opening if focus wasn't from keyboard

props.name: onOpenChangeComplete
props.description: Callback when open state change animation completes

props.name: delayDuration
props.description: Delay before showing tooltip in ms (overrides provider, default: 700)

props.name: disableHoverableContent
props.description: Prevent tooltip from staying open when hovering content

props.name: disableCloseOnTriggerClick
props.description: Prevent tooltip from staying open when trigger is clicked

props.name: ignoreNonKeyboardFocus
props.description: Prevent tooltip from opening if focus wasn't from keyboard

props.name: to
props.description: Portal target selector or element (default: body)

props.name: side
props.description: Side of anchor to position against (default: "top")

props.name: arrowPadding
props.description: Padding between arrow and content edges

props.name: avoidCollisions
props.description: Override side/align to avoid collisions (default: true)

props.name: collisionPadding
props.description: Padding around viewport for collision detection (default: 8)

interfaces.name: TabsRootProps
interfaces.description:
Props for Tabs.Root component.
Controls active tab state and provides context to children.

props.name: value
props.description:
Active tab value (bindable).
Must match a Trigger's `value` prop.

props.name: loop
props.description: Whether keyboard navigation loops at ends.

interfaces.name: TabsListProps
interfaces.description:
Props for Tabs.List component.
Container for tab triggers with role="tablist".

interfaces.name: TabsTriggerProps
interfaces.description:
Props for Tabs.Trigger component.
Individual tab button with role="tab".

props.name: value
props.description:
Tab value (required).
Links this trigger to a Content with matching value.

interfaces.name: TabsContentProps
interfaces.description:
Props for Tabs.Content component.
Tab panel with role="tabpanel".

props.name: value
props.description:
Tab value (required).
Links this content to a Trigger with matching value.

props.name: children
props.description: Content to render when tab is active.

props.name: value
props.description: Selected value (bindable) - string for single, string[] for multiple

props.name: items
props.description: Items array for typeahead and label lookup

props.name: name
props.description: Form field name for native submission

props.name: to
props.description: Portal target selector or element (default: body)

props.name: side
props.description: Side of anchor to position against (default: "bottom")

props.name: arrowPadding
props.description: Padding between arrow and content edges

props.name: avoidCollisions
props.description: Override side/align to avoid collisions (default: true)

props.name: collisionPadding
props.description: Padding around viewport for collision detection (default: 8)

props.name: label
props.description: Label for typeahead search (defaults to textContent)

props.name: children
props.type: Snippet<[{ selected: boolean; highlighted: boolean }]> | Snippet
props.description: Snippet receives { selected, highlighted } for conditional rendering

props.name: openDelay
props.description: Delay before opening on hover in ms (default: 700)

props.name: closeDelay
props.description: Delay before closing after hover ends in ms (default: 300)

props.name: to
props.description: Portal target selector or element (default: body)

props.name: side
props.description: Side of anchor to position against (default: "bottom")

props.name: arrowPadding
props.description: Padding between arrow and content edges

props.name: avoidCollisions
props.description: Override side/align to avoid collisions (default: true)

props.name: collisionPadding
props.description: Padding around viewport for collision detection (default: 8)

props.name: trapFocus
props.description: Trap focus inside popover (default: true when interacted)

props.name: to
props.description: Portal target selector or element (default: body)

props.name: to
props.description: Portal target selector or element (default: body)

props.name: closeOnEscape
props.description:
Close on escape key (default: true)
Note: Consider setting to false for critical confirmations

props.name: interactOutsideBehavior
props.description:
Behavior when interacting outside (default: "ignore")
CRITICAL: AlertDialog defaults to "ignore" unlike Dialog
This forces explicit user action (Action or Cancel button)

props.name: trapFocus
props.description: Trap focus inside alert dialog (default: true)

interfaces.name: AlertDialogActionProps
interfaces.description:
Action button - does NOT auto-close the dialog.
Used for destructive/confirming actions (Delete, Confirm, etc.)
The consumer is responsible for closing the dialog after the action.

interfaces.name: AlertDialogCancelProps
interfaces.description:
Cancel button - auto-closes the dialog.
Used for aborting the action (Cancel, Nevermind, etc.)

props.name: to
props.description: Portal target selector or element (default: body)

props.name: side
props.description: Side the sheet slides in from (default: "right")

interfaces.name: ButtonProps
interfaces.description:
Props for the Button primitive.

Extends native HTMLButtonAttributes minus `style` (enforced no inline styles).
Inherits: disabled, type, name, value, form, formAction, etc.
